title: Live Operations Run-Stream Foundation
goal: Make active runs feel live and truthful by introducing run-status SSE streaming and Mission Control delta updates without inventing fake telemetry.
scope: Implement the first live-operations slice with a run-level SSE stream, inline-dispatch compatibility for supported hosts, and Mission Control activity updates derived from real task and run transitions. Keep stdout streaming and heavier animated scan-map work out of this slice.
generation_reason: Anti-drift hardening for the repo-backed post-intake backlog.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not promote or implement this task until the current task in NEXT_TASK.md is completed and logged.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Keep this slice to run-level SSE and Mission Control truth. Defer task stdout streaming, animated target maps, and severity-flash choreography.
notes: Only stream real run and task deltas from persisted state.
Mission Control must retain a polling fallback when SSE is unavailable.

success_criteria: A run-level SSE endpoint exposes real task and run status deltas for active runs.
Supported inline dispatch no longer blocks Mission Control from receiving live state updates.
Mission Control subscribes to the run stream for active runs and falls back to existing polling otherwise.
The activity feed and run snapshot update from real streamed deltas instead of synthetic client timers.
API and browser validation cover active, completed, and SSE-unavailable states.

acceptance_criteria: An active run updates Mission Control without waiting for the old coarse poll interval.
A host without working SSE support still gets a truthful Mission Control state through the existing fallback.
No live-only state appears unless it is backed by real run or task changes.

before_promotion: The active conversational-intake task in NEXT_TASK.md is completed, logged, and removed from active status.
python3 scripts/validate_backlog_tasks.py passes with this package still queued.
The queue order stays unchanged unless TASK_QUEUE.md and the related task packages are explicitly edited together.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with the run-stream slice and the live validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the new Mission Control streaming truth and any remaining fallback limitations.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md and rerun python3 scripts/validate_backlog_tasks.py.

out_of_scope: Animated scan-beam or D3 target maps
